name: Oktoberfest Lemon & Thyme Roasted Chicken with Mashed Potatoes (Lantern Night)
brandOrRestaurant: Disney Magic · Rapunzel's Royal Table (Lantern Night)
whyItWorks: Tender roasted half-chicken with mashed potatoes, but the standard skin is basted with lemon-thyme jus.
prepOrOrderInstructions: Remove the lemon-basted chicken skin and eat the tender interior breast meat with mashed potatoes, or ask your server for the plain Lighter Note roasted chicken breast (zero lemon).
watchOuts: Lemon-thyme glaze on the skin (citrus guardrail)
